entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, with VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I'm calling about my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I... I think I need to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sarah Bell, and the order number is... VF77819-02.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your order pulled up. To make sure I understand the situation, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken. I just... I've **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** and I really **don't use it** like I thought I would. It all seems so complicated.
I see. So it's not quite meeting your expectations?
Exactly. I even looked at a **resale** website, but that's just too much work and I don't understand how it works. I feel a bit overwhelmed by the whole thing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. I understand completely. Let me just confirm the delivery date here... Okay, I see the sensor was delivered to you 36 days ago.
And looking at our policy for this item, you are well within the 90-day return window. So yes, we can absolutely process a return for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's fantastic! I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just attach that to the original packaging and you can drop it off at any local post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you again for your help, Isaac.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today at VeloFit?
Great. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
